errors.evidence: The chart is a simple horizontal bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. Each bar has its own distinct category label on the vertical axis. The description incorrectly interprets the conceptual similarity in the text of some labels as a visual grouping structure.
The description of the horizontal axis omits key details requested by the prompt. It fails to mention that the axis has no visible title, no units, and no numbered tick marks.

The prompt explicitly forbids drawing conclusions or summarizing data in this way, requiring a purely descriptive account of visual features.
